explanation_en: Shubman Gill hit a boundary off SN Thakur, adding 5.0 points to your team total through Gill. Your team total increased to 66.0, but your rank dropped by 1033 to 2306 because other teams in the pool gained more points on this ball.
explanation_hi: Shubman Gill ne SN Thakur ko chauka jad diya, boss! Apni team mein Gill ke 5.0 points aaye. Total score 66.0 ho gaya, par rank 1033 se girkar 2306 ho gayi, kyunki rival teams ne aur zyada points bator liye is ball pe.
watch_next_en: Shubman Gill now needs 22 more runs for his 30-run milestone bonus.
watch_next_hi: Shubman Gill ko ab 30-run bonus ke liye 22 runs aur chahiye bhai.
